owner_intent: Add future levels/world content via Laravel admin without shipping a new Flutter/Flame binary; launch has exactly five real levels
published_runtime_source: signed/validated/versioned Laravel catalog response; never a hardcoded array of five in Flutter
authoring_process: upload licensed master/thumbnail and complete pieces/masks/manifest for the selected geometry
server checks bytes and file types, dimensions, reference paths and puzzle geometry
validate SHA-256, all piece indices, reciprocal edges, masks/anchors/coordinates and master coverage
supply approved timing thresholds and fail/timeout rules from Q05-T before publish
preview and mark ready only after required device/compatibility acceptance for the new content
publish atomic catalog revision after access check; invalidate cached catalog, serve immutable versioned assets
previous attempt pinned to prior asset_revision, do not replace in-flight image/geometry
new levels appear in existing world/level grids after catalog refresh, no extra app screen or release

publish_gate.verified_device_content_tests: required before production publish; not claimed performed

compatibility: If new geometry, behavior, or manifest schema exceeds shipped client capability: block publish and require app release; content-only compatible additions require no app release.
asset_hosting: controlled object storage/CDN or Laravel managed files; immutable revision URL + checksum; secrets never in catalog
offline: cache last verified catalog/assets; new unverified content not offered offline; verify content_version before opening a new attempt
player_integrity: server recomputes unlocked access and reward eligibility; client never grants coins, stars, weekly score or chest from untrusted dynamic content
republication: never overwrite asset bytes for active revision; use new revision and preserve referenced assets for saved attempts
missing_owner_decisions: Q40 visual/device validation conditional; legal regional deployment gating (Q34/Q35 product policy already approved)
future_level_timing_rule: Admin must supply approved level_time_limit_seconds, 3/2-star elapsed limits; countdown, no Extra Time V1. Validate 0 < three_star ≤ two_star ≤ limit.
deploy_context: cPanel/Laravel, global distribution, Android+iOS; production API must use tested HTTPS/TLS.
